messages.subject: Re: Exchange
messages.text:
Hello Erica,
 

 Sorry about the mix-up!
 

 Here are the steps for a return/exchange: 
 

 1. Go to https://lasclay.happyreturns.com/ to obtain a return label. After entering your order number and zip code, select the products you wish to return and then choose the replacements. At the end, you will receive a prepaid return label.
 

 2. Print the label, pack the products to be returned, and affix the label on the package. Please use envelopes/bags instead of boxes, which are more expensive.
 

 3. Drop off at a Canada Post red mailbox or nearest post office.
 

 4. Once the return is received, we will send the new product(s), without charge.
 

 Warmly,
 

 __
 Gabriel 
 Co-fondateur 
 Lasclay
